scope: public, previously seen, class-balanced 30-query paired experiment; identical grounded answer service/runtime, only direct versus explore-then-answer user path differs; not independent hidden test, whole-RAG factual accuracy, or frontier proof

verification_metrics.scope: custom claim-label and cited-document+label metrics; not official sentence-rationale leaderboard scoring

timing_health.scope: Wall quantiles include valid observed clocks only; all questions remain in quality and flow metrics.

baseline.quote_check_scope: verbatim occurrence and source identifiers only; semantic support is model assessed, not independently verified

exploration_observations.byte_scope: Preview and first-original response bytes are preserved HTTP UTF-8 JSON body bytes; evidence_ready payload size is compact JSON re-encoding of parsed SSE data, excludes SSE framing/other events/HTTP headers and is not observed wire size. Preview adds requests and does not replace answer evidence.
exploration_observations.timing_scope: preview_ms and original_ms start at the user action; original_read_ms is their difference. Observed failed HTTP responses are included; only preserved and checked observations are summarized.

paired.bootstrap: paired query percentile; 10000 resamples; seed20261107; shared documents may induce dependence

latency_limits: serial local MPS, warm reused index, network and cache may differ; valid observed wall clocks, failures retained and separately summarized; not production SLA or randomized order speed causation
usage_scope: reported provider token counts including failed attempts; unavailable usage is unknown, not zero
